uploadIntro: Upload a Salesforce Lead/Opportunity export, a Genesys call report, or a Genesys interactions export (.xlsx, .xlsm, or .csv). You can select multiple files at once.
uploadFlaggedToast: "{filename}": {count} row(s) need review for implausible values.
uploadEmpty: No activity in this report — ignored.
uploadReimportBatch: Re-import all files in this batch
uploadLogLegacy: Uploaded before a report-date parsing fix — re-import to refresh and re-check its data.
uploadSkipped: Not matched to a team member: {names}
flaggedBannerBody: Implausible call values (e.g. over 24 hours) were skipped on import instead of being trusted as-is.
rescanBannerBody: {count} older call reports haven't been checked for implausible values yet.
rescanDoneClean: Check complete — no implausible values found.
notLinkedBody: Your account isn't linked to a Performance dashboard or to a name from the reports yet. Ask an admin to set it up under Performance → Settings.
dashboardEmptyBody: Upload a Salesforce or call report to see team KPIs here.
dashboardLoggedInTitle: Logged in to Genesys per day
dashboardSubtitle: {ym} · {count} employees in report · VM = last month, VJ = same month last year
dashboardMissingReport: Call report missing for {days}. These workdays still count as worked days so FC1 isn't inflated — please upload them.
dashboardClosedWonSubtitle: Closes through {date} · see FC1 for comparison
dashboardForecastFootnote: FC2 and FC3 extrapolate leads and workable to month-end (workday {elapsed} of {total}). Stock values (Analysis, open opportunities …) are point-in-time counts and aren't compared.
callsFootnote: Daily values from the Genesys call report. The month's average call duration is weighted (total talk time ÷ total calls); average logged in per day counts days with login time.
developmentSubtitle: Trend over the last 3 months up to today.
wonPerWorkdayFootnote: Daily average = Closed Won ÷ worked days. Worked days are days with own calls; workdays without any call report count too, a day without own calls counts as a day off.
wonTrendFootnote: Workdays over the last 3 months. Days above the average are marked green, days below red.

analysis30.title: Analysis > 30 days
analysis30.desc: Leads with status Analysis older than 30 days.

leads14.title: Leads: last activity > 2 weeks
leads14.desc: Active leads (Open/Analysis) with no activity in over 14 days.

opp_overdue.title: Overdue opportunities
opp_overdue.desc: Open opportunities whose close date is in the past.

opps14.title: Opportunities: last activity > 2 weeks
opps14.desc: Open opportunities with no activity in over 14 days.

settingsIntro: Which dashboards exist, which intranet teams belong to them, and which person stands behind each name in the reports. Leads of linked teams see the team view, everyone else only their own numbers.
settingsDialogHint: Members of the selected teams and departments belong to this dashboard. Their lead sees the team view.
settingsNoTeams: Not linked to a team yet
settingsDeleteHint: Only possible while it has no names and no uploaded reports.
settingsLinkedCount: {linked} of {total} names linked to a person
settingsLinksHint: Only people linked here see their own numbers.
settingsAutoLinkDone: {count, plural, =0 {No new links found} one {# name linked} other {# names linked}}
settingsNoEmployees: No names yet — they appear with the first Salesforce upload.
uploadRawKept: Open leads/opportunities stay at the newer report from {date}.
uploadSkippedHint: Names are linked to people under Performance → Settings. Agents from other teams are skipped on purpose.
uploadSkippedShow: {count, plural, one {# name not matched} other {# names not matched}}
uploadSortedHint: Salesforce files are uploaded first so call and interaction reports already know the names.
dailyStatusHint: Which reports have been uploaded for the last workdays (by report date).
uploadTooLarge: The file is larger than 4 MB and can't be uploaded. Limit the export to fewer columns or a shorter period, or save it as .xlsx (much smaller than .csv).
compareFootnoteRunning: VM/VJ: the running month is compared with last month and the same month last year at the same workday (workday {workday}, i.e. up to {date}). FC1 is compared with the comparison month's final result.
compareFootnoteDone: VM/VJ: completed month, compared with the complete previous month and the same month last year.
dataStatusStale: Older than the rest of the data — check the uploads
teamActivityHint: Genesys values for the month. Interactions per day are on the Interactions tab.
marksHint: Top performer and Needs attention appear from the 5th workday and with at least 6 employees with enough workables.
uploadIntroWallbox: Upload the two Wallbox reports: KI_DashboardData_Wallbox_Leads (campaign member status) and KI_DashboardData_Wallbox_Opps (opportunities). Calls come from the shared Genesys call report – it can be uploaded in any dashboard and goes into all of them.
uploadIntroCalls: This dashboard only shows calls. They come from the shared Genesys call report (plus the interactions export, optionally) – it can be uploaded in any dashboard and goes into every one whose team has the person.
uploadSortedHintWallbox: The Wallbox opportunity report is uploaded before the campaign report so the first names in the member status map to the right people.
settingsKindHint: For Wallbox and calls-only dashboards the people come from the linked intranet teams automatically.

wallbox.outOfStepHint: The two Wallbox reports are not from the same day – in progress and opportunities won't quite line up.
wallbox.emptyBody: Admins upload the two Wallbox reports (member status and opportunities) under Uploads.
wallbox.rateHint: Won ÷ (won + lost) – only closed opportunities count.
wallbox.deltaHint: Arrows: change since the previous upload.
wallbox.evHint: Of which contacts with at least one EV card ("min. 1 EV").
wallbox.footnote: In progress comes from "In Progress – first name" in the campaign report; other statuses are campaign-wide and not tied to an employee. Lost = closed and not won.
wallbox.devSubtitle: One point per upload day of the Wallbox reports.
wallbox.devOnePoint: The trend appears from the second upload day.
wallbox.employeeEmpty: The current Wallbox report has nothing for this person yet.
wallbox.notWallbox: This person isn't on a Wallbox dashboard.

uploadNotImported: Not imported into: {dashboards} — busy or failed there. Please upload the file there again.
adminsOnlyHint: Performance is not released yet: others see "being reworked". Release via the Convex variable PERFORMANCE_MODE=live and the maintenance list.
viewAsHint: Shows Performance the way this person sees it (even before release). Uploads and settings stay yours.
